module_summary: AXI-Stream to 32-bit XGMII Ethernet transmitter: a 9-state FSM emits preamble, payload, padding, LFSR-computed FCS and deficit-idle IFG from a one-word input register.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/PREAMBLE/PAYLOAD/PAD/FCS/ERR/IFG FSM selecting XGMII output and tready

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input frame payload, keep-masked into s_tdata_reg

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input valid starts frames and detects underflow mid-frame

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready from s_axis_tready_reg, asserted by FSM per state

anchors.name: xgmii_txd
anchors.why: XGMII transmit data: idle, start/preamble, payload, FCS, terminate

anchors.name: xgmii_txc
anchors.why: XGMII per-lane control flags accompanying xgmii_txd

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker moving FSM to pad/FCS and ending frame

anchors.name: s_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Registered input word feeding XGMII output and CRC LFSRs

anchors.name: crc_state_reg
anchors.why: Ethernet CRC32 states (full and partial widths) forming FCS bytes

anchors.name: ifg_count_reg
anchors.why: Inter-frame gap countdown holding FSM in IFG state

anchors.name: frame_min_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining bytes to minimum frame length; triggers PAD state

anchors.name: cfg_tx_enable
anchors.why: Enables starting a new frame from IDLE

anchors.name: s_empty_reg
anchors.why: Empty-byte count of last word selecting FCS alignment

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: In-frame flag keeping IFG and draining remaining input of dropped frame

anchors.name: frame_error_reg
anchors.why: Frame error (underflow or tuser) diverting FSM to ERR state

anchors.name: deficit_idle_count_reg
anchors.why: Deficit idle count carried between frames for DIC

anchors.name: update_crc
anchors.why: Enables CRC state update during payload/pad/FCS

anchors.name: fcs_output_txd_0
anchors.why: First FCS cycle data merging tail bytes and CRC

anchors.name: fcs_output_txd_1
anchors.why: Second FCS cycle data with remaining CRC and terminate

anchors.name: extra_cycle
anchors.why: Full last word needs FCS_3 terminate cycle

anchors.name: ifg_offset
anchors.why: IFG adjustment from terminate lane position

anchors.name: cfg_ifg
anchors.why: Configured inter-frame gap length loaded into ifg counter

anchors.name: s_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Byte keep mask for data masking and empty count

anchors.name: s_axis_tuser
anchors.why: User bit marking bad frame, forcing error termination

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata_masked
anchors.why: Input data with unkept bytes zeroed

anchors.name: start_packet
anchors.why: Start-of-packet pulse after preamble

anchors.name: error_underflow
anchors.why: Pulse when input underflows mid-frame

anchors.name: m_axis_ptp_ts
anchors.why: PTP timestamp output, disabled by PTP_TS_ENABLE default

anchors.name: m_axis_ptp_ts_valid
anchors.why: PTP timestamp valid, disabled by default parameters

groups.name: TX FSM
groups.description: Frame sequencing controller producing tready, CRC control and XGMII selection

groups.name: Input staging
groups.description: Masks and registers input word and empty count

groups.name: CRC and FCS
groups.description: Parallel LFSR CRC32 units and FCS insertion data per tail alignment

groups.name: Frame timing counters
groups.description: Minimum-length padding, inter-frame gap and deficit idle counters

groups.name: PTP timestamp
groups.description: Optional start-of-packet timestamp capture, disabled by default
